amount_or_product_check.name: amount_or_product_check
amount_or_product_check.value: ("checkout"."product_id" IS NOT NULL OR ("checkout"."amount_cents" IS NOT NULL AND "checkout"."currency_code" IS NOT NULL))

delivery_log_source_check.name: delivery_log_source_check
delivery_log_source_check.value: "delivery_log"."webhook_id" IS NOT NULL OR "delivery_log"."app_installation_id" IS NOT NULL

crypto_or_fiat_constraint.name: crypto_or_fiat_constraint
crypto_or_fiat_constraint.value: ("payout"."selected_asset_code" IS NOT NULL AND "payout"."transaction_hash" IS NOT NULL) OR ("payout"."bank_account" IS NOT NULL)
